LanguageData.CC_Settings_Connection_ShowDormantConnec: Pawns will show that they have a dormant Connection in their inspect window. Won't show what it exactly is.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DisableEmpire_Tooltip: When enabled, the Empire faction (Royalty DLC) will not appear during Cosmere scenario world generation.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DisableOdyssey_Label: Disable Odyssey Factions in Cosmere Scenarios
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DisableOdyssey_Tooltip: When enabled, Mechanoid Hive and Insect Geneline factions (Odyssey DLC) will not appear during Cosmere scenario world generation.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_LogLevel_Tooltip: Determines what gets logged. Should probably be Info
LanguageData.CC_Settings_Quickstarter_Tooltip: When in dev mode, will immediately launch into the given Quickstarter. Very useful for testing.
